room_roles.title: Signal roles: {room}
room_roles.description:
Choose how each signal contributes to occupancy.

- Trigger occupancy: activity (e.g. PIR motion) gives immediate occupancy, but a trigger that stays on too long is ignored as stuck.
- Maintain occupancy: while active (radar presence, PC activity, bed), vacancy cannot be confirmed.
- Confirm vacancy: like Maintain, and its cleared state also counts as evidence that the room is empty (faster vacancy).
- Ignore: kept but not used.

Door contacts only count as movement and never prove on their own that someone is inside. Mark a signal as inverted if it means activity when it is off (e.g. a "PC idle" sensor).

category_remove.title: Remove categories
category_remove.description: Profile entries for removed categories are removed too. Labels in Home Assistant are kept.

category_create_labels.title: Create missing labels
category_create_labels.description: Create Home Assistant labels for: {categories}. No label is applied to any entity.

profiles.title: Mood profiles
profiles.description: Edit one profile entry. Inheritance: Global → Room override → Individual light override (the most specific value wins). The Smart Lighting and Smart Room Lighting dashboard cards offer the same settings with previews; changes made here are saved immediately and do not reload the integration.

profile_edit.title: {scope} profile: {mood} / {target}
profile_edit.description: Room: {room}. Leave a field empty to inherit it from the less specific level. Ambient: follow the mood even while the room is vacant.

occupancy.title: Occupancy timing
occupancy.description: Defaults for every room, in seconds. Each room can override them under Rooms.

data_description.correlation_window: Signals within this window corroborate each other (e.g. door, then motion). Also how long a new signal must last to confirm occupancy on its own.
data_description.exit_confirmation: Quiet time needed before vacancy when there is positive evidence (a Confirm-vacancy sensor cleared, a door exit, or occupancy was never confirmed).
data_description.inactivity_timeout: Quiet time needed before vacancy without positive evidence.
data_description.dropout_grace: A Maintain or Confirm-vacancy signal that clears for less than this is ignored.
data_description.trigger_stuck_after: A Trigger signal active longer than this is ignored as stuck. 0 disables.
data_description.presence_stuck_after: A Maintain or Confirm-vacancy signal active longer than this is ignored as stuck. 0 disables (default; people can sit still for hours).
data_description.startup_hold: After start-up or reload, the previous occupancy is kept at least this long. Vacancy is never confirmed earlier.
